subject.title: [Telegram] 机器人头像更改后无法同步到 Telegram 客户端

question: Should OpenClaw mutate the public Telegram bot profile photo from assistant-avatar changes, and if so should that be an explicit user action, an opt-in setting, or unsupported?
rationale: This crosses from local OpenClaw identity rendering into external Telegram account/profile mutation using bot-token authority, so automation should not choose the consent, source-of-truth, and security boundary.

options.title: Explicit opt-in sync action
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned action or control that requires operator intent, uses `setMyProfilePhoto`, reports failures, and includes live Telegram proof.

options.title: Manual Telegram ownership
options.body: Keep OpenClaw assistant avatars local and document that Telegram bot profile photos are managed through Telegram/BotFather.

options.title: Automatic bidirectional sync
options.body: Propagate avatar changes automatically both ways, accepting higher surprise, conflict-resolution, and privacy risk.

recommendation.title: Explicit opt-in sync action
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned action or control that requires operator intent, uses `setMyProfilePhoto`, reports failures, and includes live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the clearest merged history on the avatar identity surface and is best positioned to decide the product/security boundary.
